_comment: Canonical registry of field types and widget names understood by all three stacks (Go, Python, TypeScript). A record template section references one of these 'type' values. Widget names match component identifiers in the frontend. Only widgets whose structure a generic field type can't express are registered — prefer text/select/multiselect/scale (optionally with display=pills or allow_other): their AI schema is derived generically from `options`, no Go/Python/React changes needed per new field. Of the registered widgets only `risk` is AI-fillable; the rest are manual-only and the AI service drops any value the model volunteers for them. Retired bespoke widgets (task_checklist, session_evaluation, task_adherence, functionality, formulation_5f, spa_history, functional_analysis, distress_scale) survive only in archived template versions: the frontend keeps their renderers and the PDF exporter keeps their layouts, but new template saves reject them and the AI no longer fills them.

type_modifiers.display: "pills" (select|multiselect only) — render as toggle pill buttons instead of a dropdown/checkboxes
type_modifiers.allow_other: bool (multiselect only) — lets the professional add a free-text value beyond the fixed options; the AI may also emit values outside the option list

mental_exam.description: Mental-status exam checklist (porte, orientación, afecto, pensamiento, percepción, ideación suicida)
mental_exam.ai: manual-only — compliance rule: the AI never marks exam options, the professional decides

risk.description: Risk assessment widget — writes the system risk_level field (NONE|IDEATION|PLAN|ATTEMPT)
risk.ai_schema: one of: NONE, IDEATION, PLAN, ATTEMPT

treatment_plan.description: Structured therapeutic goals and interventions (self-contained panel backed by its own tables)
treatment_plan.ai: manual-only — the renderer ignores section values

diagnoses.description: ICD-10 diagnoses panel (self-contained; AI suggestions travel separately via suggested_icd10)
diagnoses.ai: manual-only — the renderer ignores section values
